hero.title: Seeing heat.
hero.premise: Can a learned image representation distinguish three thermal-image classes?
hero.note: The opening is a schematic temperature field, not a patient image or calibrated measurement.

ending.title: A method is only as strong as its evaluation.
ending.text: The useful outcome is a traceable experiment: representations, classifier, split, and reported evidence. Next I would reconcile the final result, establish patient-level separation, and evaluate an external cohort.

scenes.label: Seeing heat
scenes.title: A different kind of image.
scenes.caption: Colour encodes relative intensity in a schematic field. No measured temperatures or patient sample are displayed.

scenes.label: The experiment
scenes.title: Three classes. One curated experiment.
scenes.caption: The source write-up reports 614 images per class: 430 train, 123 validation, 61 test. These are image counts, not independent patient counts.

scenes.label: Representation
scenes.title: Pixels become a representation.
scenes.caption: Conceptual convolution and feature extraction, not an exported activation map. The selected image becomes input to a learned representation.

scenes.label: Two pathways
scenes.title: Same input. Different extractors.
scenes.caption: VGG16 and ResNet50 provide alternative representations. Branches are methodological diagrams, not measured feature values.

scenes.label: Hybrid model
scenes.title: Represent first. Classify second.
scenes.caption: CNN features feed XGBoost. This tree diagram explains the architecture; it is not a trained decision tree or a patient prediction.

scenes.label: Results
scenes.title: A larger number needs a source.
scenes.caption: Reported training and validation accuracies. ResNet50 validation differs between the original article (85.63%) and About (73.17%); neither is reconciled.

scenes.label: Class-level evidence
scenes.title: Which mistakes does accuracy hide?
scenes.caption: No numeric confusion matrix is available in the inspected sources. Question marks mark unknown counts; they are not zeros or implied predictions.

scenes.label: Research outcome
scenes.title: Keep the evidence with the claim.
scenes.caption: IEEE CENIM 2024 publication; result reconciliation, patient independence, and external validation remain questions to investigate.

hero.title: Eleven seconds.
hero.premise: How did the home outfield shape change through one observed passage?
hero.note: Actual Home coordinates on a 105 × 68 m pitch. Snapshot transitions explain change; they are not a continuous tracking replay.

ending.title: Measure the shape. Keep the context.
ending.text: A narrower team shape is a descriptive result. It does not prove successful defending or reveal tactical intent. The passage ends with an Away off-target shot, and the missing ball interval stays visible.

scenes.label: One passage
scenes.title: Start with observed positions.
scenes.caption: Home outfield positions at 298.88 s; Player11 excluded as goalkeeper. Metrica anonymized identifiers are retained.

scenes.label: Team structure
scenes.title: A team has a boundary.
scenes.caption: Actual convex hull and centroid of the Home outfield players at 298.88 s. Hull is spatial context; compactness measurements use width and length.

scenes.label: The ball changes the picture
scenes.title: The centre is far from the ball.
scenes.caption: Observed 303.08 s snapshot: centroid-to-ball distance peaks at 22.007 m. Positions and ball come from the pinned source.

scenes.label: Measure change
scenes.title: Less width. A different position.
scenes.caption: At 310.12 s, Home width is 24.900 m versus 30.861 m initially. Centroid displacement is 5.073 m. Width and length are axis-aligned spread, not hull area.

scenes.label: Missing evidence
scenes.title: A gap is part of the story.
scenes.caption: A 1.04-second gap separates valid analysis frames at 307.92 and 308.96 s. The trace breaks across the missing interior. Away recovers at 308.96 s, correcting the legacy Home-regain wording.

scenes.label: Tactical restraint
scenes.title: Shape describes. It does not explain intent.
scenes.caption: The source event window and measurement trace support a descriptive claim about one passage. They do not establish a team-wide defensive rating.

hero.title: Records become patterns.
hero.premise: What does it take to turn analytical work into something a business owner can use?
hero.note: The plotted series is the repository’s monthly item_sold example, not verified customer revenue.

ending.title: The contract is part of the model.
ending.text: Machine learning, cloud, and Android must agree on what a request means and what the response contains. The prototype and source code preserve that learning; they do not establish business impact or production reliability.

scenes.label: Business records
scenes.title: A record is not yet an insight.
scenes.caption: Last 36 monthly item_sold observations from the repository example. Units are items sold, not income; no forecast values are invented.

scenes.label: Preparation
scenes.title: The model sees a window.
scenes.caption: The checked-in code uses MinMax scaling fit on training data, a 12-step input, and an 18-step held-out tail. The diagram describes that implementation.

scenes.label: Prediction
scenes.title: One output becomes the next input.
scenes.caption: The training script uses an LSTM with 64 units and Dense(1), then rolls predictions forward for 12 monthly steps. No saved prediction series or accuracy is displayed.

scenes.label: Basket analysis
scenes.title: Different records. Different questions.
scenes.caption: Top item-row counts and Coffee/Bread basket co-occurrence derived from Bakery.csv. 852 of 9,465 baskets contain both. Co-occurrence is not causation or a recommendation score.

scenes.label: Team integration
scenes.title: A forecast has to cross a boundary.
scenes.caption: Python model work, Flask service, cloud integration, and Android. The inspected prediction route calculates forecasts but returns original dataframe records; returned forecasts are not claimed.

scenes.label: Prototype outcome
scenes.title: A prototype is one kind of evidence.
scenes.caption: Bangkit graduation prototype, source code, and integration learning are recorded. Verified deployment, customer adoption, and reproducible model-performance figures are absent.
